exposure: normotensive pregnancies with intrauterine growth restriction
normotensive pregnancies with appropriate for gestational age infants
normotensive pregnancies with appropriate for gestational age (AGA) infants
normotensive pregnancies with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR)
outcome: methemoglobin (MetHb) levels in umbilical arterial blood
cohort: 121 pregnant women divided into three groups: preeclampsia (n=42), normotensive IUGR (n=37), and normotensive AGA (n=42)
finding: MetHb levels were significantly lower in the IUGR group compared to the AGA group, suggesting that NO may play a key role in the pathogenesis of IUGR.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between the three groups studied (preeclampsia, appropriate for gestational age, and intrauterine growth restriction).
birth_weight: <10th percentile for birth weight in the IUGR group
